changelog:
Initial release of Meta Ads API skill.

- Full read/write integration with Meta (Facebook) Ads API.
- Manage ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, and ad creatives.
- Access detailed performance insights and metrics for accounts and campaigns.
- Provides clear setup instructions, required permissions, and authentication steps.
- Includes ready-to-use API request examples for all major ad management actions.
summary: Manage Meta (Facebook) Ads campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, and access performance metrics via full read/write API integration.
